0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 0-2 on the road) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, winners of six straight and first in the West) as they look to win their first road game of the 2026-27 season. The Pelicans are missing Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while the Grizzlies are without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30.
